name: qa-transfer-pricing
description: Qatar mainland transfer pricing for the 2026 tax year, covering associated enterprises, Qatar permanent establishments, the arm's length computation, functional analysis, comparable updates, transfer pricing declarations, master and local files, record retention and Qatar-parent country-by-country reporting. Use for Qatar related-party services, goods, financing, intercompany charges, documentation thresholds, or Dhareeba transfer pricing filing questions. Separates entity turnover and asset tests from the multinational group revenue test and records the current suspension of subsidiary local filing, with the Qatar legislation, GTA circular and jurisdiction-confirmed implementation evidence. Includes bilateral APA application and rollback procedures. Produces a sourced working paper for professional review; Qatar Financial Centre rules and the separate global minimum tax computation require their own analysis.
